DESCRIPTION:
At Solvias, we are ideally placed to provide stability testing for all stages of drug development. Our stability storage infrastructure includes sophisticated walk-in chambers, climate cabinets and an emergency backup for power breakdown. All our processes take place on one connected site, where there is a high degree of QC expertise, scientific dialogue and maximal sample preservation.

Testing we regularly perform includes:

-  Long-term stability studies according to ICH guidelines
- Ongoing and follow-up stability studies
- Comparability studies
- Stress tests, forced degradation
- Photostability testing according to ICH guidelines
- In-use tests, freeze-thaw cycles
- Excipient/API compatibility
- Interaction studies with primary packaging
- Stability protocols, reports and interim reports
- Stability indicated method development
- Identification of unknown/new impurities

DESCRIPTION:
We manage long-term and accelerated stability studies under GMP compliance to ensure the safety and efficacy of your candidate products.

Please contact us for a customized quotation.

Stability studies include:

- Stability protocol and report
- Preparation of specifications
- Sampling
- Management of stability programs (real-time, stressed, accelerated)
- Management of reference standards, retention samples
- Forced degradation studies to develop stability indicating methods
- Stability compliance tools
- Continuous improvement culture including KPIs to monitor performance
- Well maintained equipment, validated and monitored storage units, emergency power back-up

We handle all aspects of sponsor stability programs. Expertise extends beyond routine sample analysis to the development and validation of stability-indicating methods. We will develop a complete package, generating a protocol according to client requirements, store samples, perform analytical testing, make stability calculations, prepare interim and final reports and maintain stability tables.

Data is maintained within our controlled database infrastructure. Additionally, the group has experience with several data management systems such as SAP and can provide input into client systems.

- Short and long term studies
- Continuously monitored sample storage
- ICH stability storage conditions
- Accelerated and forced-degradation
- Pre-formulation stability assessment

Our experts have thorough knowledge of FDA and EMA Bioanalytical guidelines.

Application  Imazalil has been used as reference standard in direct analysis in real time mass spectrometry (DART-MS) technique for determination of xenobiotics from fruit samples.  It may have been used as reference standard in Flow injection photoinduced chemiluminescence method for determination of Imazalil concentration from water samples.
